about: Named sinks that aren't in the FGS swallet survey or NHD, placed where their largest creek ends. The pipeline names a creek's terminal sink from FGS swallets first, then these.

sinks.name: Alachua Sink
sinks.source: USGS GNIS (Landforms, class Basin); Paynes Prairie's drain

sinks.name: Haile Sink
sinks.source: Hand-placed at the end of Hogtown Creek; not in FGS, GNIS, or NHD

sinks.name: Rose Sink
sinks.source: Hand-placed at the end of Rose Creek near Lake City; not in FGS, GNIS, or NHD
